verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search API, since some search engines and index providers offer on-prem or self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a hosted API reached with an API key against Brave's own index. The self-hostable pieces (the MCP server wrapper and third-party tools like Open WebUI) are clients of that API, not the core search index, so nothing shows the core product can be self-hosted.
